author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
This is a small guide made by yours truely to help players understand how to make maps.

More Guides for other Gamemodes will be released soon

I'll be using map YML's to help with this operation.

DTM:

-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
info:
  title: Halcyon I
  world: Halcyon1
  version: 1.0
  type: dtm
  creators:
  - KyloCode
  spawn: -34.5,85,-816.5,-90,0
  time: 6000

teams:
  purple:
    spawn: 14.5,74,-871.5,0,0
    title: Purple Team
    max: 16
    monuments:
      a:
        name: Left
        location: 41,74,-773
      b:
        name: Right
        location: -13,74,-773
  red:
    spawn: 14.5,74,-761.5,-180,0
    title: Red Team
    max: 16
    monuments:
      a:
        name: Left
        location: -13,74,-861
      b:
        name: Right
        location: 41,74,-861

remove-drops:
- leather helmet
- leather chestplate
- iron leggings
- leather boots
- stone sword
- bow
- diamond pickaxe

repair-drops:
- stone sword
- bow
- diamond pickaxe

loadout:
  effects:
  - damage resistance:5,5
  helmet:
    item: leather helmet
  chestplate:
    item: leather chestplate
  leggings:
    item: iron leggings
  boots:
    item: leather boots
  0:
    item: stone sword
  1:
    item: bow
  2:
    item: diamond pickaxe
    enchants:
    - dig_speed:1
  3:
    item: apple
    amount: 8
  4:
    item: golden apple
    amount: 1
  5:
    item: log
    amount: 32
  6:
    item: glass
    amount: 64
  27:
    item: arrow
    amount: 64

regions:
  red-spawn:
    type: cylinder
    center: 14,70,-762
    radius: 8
    height: 12
    flags:
      build:
        who: '*'
        message: '&cYou are not allowed to build in spawn!'
      damage:
        who: 'red'
  purple-spawn:
    type: cylinder
    center: 14,70,-872
    radius: 8
    height: 12
    flags:
      build:
        who: '*'
        message: '&cYou are not allowed to build in spawn!'
      damage:
        who: 'purple'
  everywhere:
    type: global
    flags:
      kill_player:
        who: '*'
        allow: true
        triggers:
          give_loadout:
            loadout:
              0:
                item: golden apple
              1:
                item: apple
  boundary:
    type: cuboid
    min: 49,89,-892
    max: -19,64,-741
    invert: true
    flags:
      build:
        who: '*'
        message: '&cYou may not build beyond this map''s restriction boundaries.'
-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-

INFO:

Let's start from the beginning
info:
  title: Halcyon I
  world: Halcyon1
  version: 1.0
  type: dtm
  creators:
  - KyloCode
  spawn: -34.5,85,-816.5,-90,0
  time: 6000

info:
 - The start of a YML 
 - No indentation needed

title:
 - The title of the map in-game
 - 2 Space bar indent
 - Space between title: and map title

world:
  - The world name in the Repo
  - Cannot have any Spaces in world name
  - 2 space bar indent
  - Space between world: and world name

version:
  - The version of the map
  - 2 space bar indent
  - Space between version: and version of map

type: 
  - The type of gamemode
  - 2 space bar indent
  - Space between type: and gamemode

creators:
  - The creators that appear in-game
  - The creators are listed below "creators" with a hyphen and a space then the name


contributors:
  - Optional (works like creators but doesn't announce in game)

spawn:
  - The Spectator spawn coordinates
  - X,Y,Z.Ya, P
     - The Yaw (Ya) will be the direction you face and the Pitch (P) will always be 0
(Example for where to find Yaw for 1.8 (ignore Pitch as it will always be 0): http://imgur.com/CqHmJNj)
     - Round the Yaw cord to one of these 0, 45, 90, 135, 180, -45, -90, -135
     - The X and Z coordinates must have .5 after the number for accurate teleportation
     - No Spaces between the coordinate numbers 

time:
  - Optional (sets time of day to that time)

-------------------------
TEAMS:
teams:
  purple:
    spawn: 14.5,74,-871.5,0,0
    title: Purple Team
    max: 16
    monuments:
      a:
        name: Left
        location: 41,74,-773
      b:
        name: Right
        location: -13,74,-773
  red:
    spawn: 14.5,74,-761.5,-180,0
    title: Red Team
    max: 16
    monuments:
      a:
        name: Left
        location: -13,74,-861
      b:
        name: Right
        location: 41,74,-861

purple/red:
   - Selects team color of the map
      - You may use: 
- black (&0) (Not recommended, Hard to see in chat)
- navy (&1)
- green (&2)
- cyan (&3)
- red (&4)
- purple (&5)
- orange (&6)
- light_gray (&7)
- gray (&8)
- blue (&9)
- lime (&a)
- light_red (&c)
- yellow (&d)
- pink (&e)
- white (&f) (Not recommended, Mixes with player chat)

spawn: 
  - Refer to "spawn" in the Info: section

title:
  - Display title of the team

max:
  - Max number of players eligible to join 

monuments:
  -Max 6 (A, B, C, D, E, F)

a (or b,c,d,e,f):
  name:
  location: 

Name: refers to the name that is displayed on the scoreboard

location: is the location of the monument (X,Y,Z)

--------------------------
REGION:

regions:
  red-spawn:
    type: cylinder
    center: 14,70,-762
    radius: 8
    height: 12
    flags:
      build:
        who: '*'
        message: '&cYou are not allowed to build in spawn!'
      damage:
        who: 'red'
  purple-spawn:
    type: cylinder
    center: 14,70,-872
    radius: 8
    height: 12
    flags:
      build:
        who: '*'
        message: '&cYou are not allowed to build in spawn!'
      damage:
        who: 'purple'
  everywhere:
    type: global
    flags:
      kill_player:
        who: '*'
        allow: true
        triggers:
          give_loadout:
            loadout:
              0:
                item: golden apple
              1:
                item: apple
  boundary:
    type: cuboid
    min: 49,89,-892
    max: -19,64,-741
    invert: true
    flags:
      build:
        who: '*'
        message: '&cYou may not build beyond this map''s restriction boundaries.'

red-spawn, boundary, purple-spawn:
  - Region Names
     - Name them to whatever you want but make it easily identifiable
  - Indent of 2 after regions:

type: 
   List of types: (indent of 3)
   - Cuboid
   - Global
   - Point
   - Cylinder

type: cuboid
Makes a box type shape with the coordinates given in the min and max

type: cylinder
Makes a cylinder around the center coordinate with a given radius and height

type: point
Makes  the specific point you input to either a CTW (soon to be released) chest function or a simple enchantment table protection

type: global
Usually used for kill rewards, Global gives affect to the whole map 

(Cuboid) (indent of 3)
min:
Max:
Doesn't matter what coord you put into the 2, it just determines where the box region from the 2 coordinates.

(Cylinder)
Center:
The center of the cylinder

radius: (indent of 3)
The radius (how wide) the cylinder is

height: (indent of 3)
How high the cylinder is


flags: (build, enter, damage(will add more soon)) (indent of 3)
The flag that is with the region

build: (flag) (indent of 6)
Makes it so players cannot destroy blocks within the cylinder, point, cuboid region

who: '*' (indent of 8)
The astrick means that both teams are affected while if you put "red" then only red team is affected

message:
Can be colored
Displays a message when the player doesn't abide by the regional rules

invert:
Inverts the region


-----------
  everywhere:
    type: global
    flags:
      kill_player:
        who: '*'
        allow: true
        triggers:
          give_loadout:
            loadout:
              0:
                item: golden apple
              1:
                item: apple

Kill rewards

The give_loadout: is triggered by the trigger:'s flag of "kill_player" which grants them an apple and a gold apple

------------------------------
------------------------------

Any questions?
Post down below
vvvvv

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Night Vision:


Under "Loadout" do this:

loadout:

  effects:

  - night_vision:1

then continue the Loadout


For ID in the red stained clay/glass, you can give the player:

stained_clay:14 for stained clay and for glass do stained_glass:14
